workflow_lessons: Do not use numeric progress bars or /100 scores for scholarly/source accuracy unless there is a precise audited denominator. Use role/status labels plus caveats.
Exact-name missing files can be convenience/fronting candidates rather than new content; compare against already-public ZIP contents before treating them as new deliverables.
No-patch survival packages are valuable anti-regression evidence but should be labeled as support/provenance, not reader releases or certification.
Local package folders without a lane ZIP should be recorded as follow-up context, not as pending Zenodo uploads.
